arguments.data: Darwin on arm64, user context is unprivileged, several loopback listeners

executor.text: The host is a Darwin arm64 machine running as an unprivileged user. Loopback has a handful of listeners; 2121 answers with a vsftpd 2.3.4 banner.
vsftpd 2.3.4 carries CVE-2011-2523, a backdoor in the shipped tarball, CVSS 9.8. A Metasploit module exists for it.
Exploitation was not carried out: msfconsole with a resource script is a tier 2 action and is waiting on the operator's decision in the drawer.
